purpose: Local source identity record for the narrow PR 1 checker

source.runtime_byte_verification: Exact SHA-256 check before source integration

h2bc12_identifier_evidence.basis: Reused recorded identifier audit; no fresh external name lookup
h2bc12_identifier_evidence.fingerprint_scope: Canonical Git blob bytes at the recorded commit; reference identity only
h2bc12_identifier_evidence.runtime_byte_verification: Not performed for this audit by run.py

comparison_rules.numeric_comparison: Exact decimal equality by default; explicit decimal-places option rounds only the source
comparison_rules.match_statuses: value_matches for exact agreement; value_matches_after_rounding when rounding is explicitly requested
comparison_rules.exit_codes: 0 for either match status; 1 for differing, missing or unresolved evidence; 2 for input errors
comparison_rules.numeric_text_policy: Decimal numeric syntax, including Unicode digits, underscores and signed zero; original JSON number tokens retained
comparison_rules.sample_and_scale_whitespace: Trim surrounding claim whitespace and preserve the original claim fields
comparison_rules.rounding_rule: ROUND_HALF_UP; claim must fit the declared number of decimal places
comparison_rules.rounding_resource_limit: Requests requiring over 1000 digits of intermediate precision are rejected as input errors; engineering limit subject to review
comparison_rules.claim_value_input: Numeric string or JSON number; JSON decimals are parsed with Decimal before comparison; booleans and null are rejected
comparison_rules.blank_fields: Empty or whitespace-only value fields remain missing
comparison_rules.zero: Numeric zero is a recorded value
comparison_rules.unknown_names: Insufficient information unless the documented H2BC12 lookup applies
comparison_rules.gene_whitespace: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from the claimed gene name; preserve internal whitespace, case and original input
comparison_rules.identifier_validation: Claim gene/sample/scale are nonempty after trimming; source identifiers are nonempty and unpadded

limits: Fingerprints identify file versions; they do not validate measurement accuracy
Sample identity follows the supplied header; no independent specimen identity validation
This record documents the current implementation; the checker does not load it as configuration
Public sharing and reuse terms remain to be reviewed for the specific submission
ai_assistance: Prepared with AI assistance and checked locally against the recorded files
